nodes.title: kon/name: every drawn arc is declared to the layout audit and kept clear by every chip; find's '≠' row is placed wholly above or below the figure's whole box (lines, arcs, points, letters with one letter height), at its side only on a wide screen; find serves only figures that leave that band at 360 (ROW_GAP 8 board px beyond the board, moved up or down, else rays shortened alike to at least 0.8). The wide arc runs WIDE_ROOM 16 inside the shortest ray (at most 84), drawn and tapped alike; find needs it at 70 or more. Say's play-out arc for an undrawn angle is one solid stroke; its dashed rays sit on the side away from the lit sector. Reverse if: the served find pool gets too narrow (a measured shortcut over 1 in 5 from figure shape), then let the row sit in a stacked column beside the figure at 360 instead of refusing figures.
